text: Reproduced exact r23/r24 export failures. Positive optimized arms become folded inverse fields at boundary; pure +3 mm translation independently fails old inverse at boundary (returns ~0 instead of -3). Boundary-cell continuation in inverse/export repairs all six frozen C04 cases without threshold changes; original four successful C4 landmark scores and all C5 scores unchanged to roundoff. Broader engine test recovers 8 mm fixture; 4 and 12 mm topology failures retained. Recording provenance and JVM/JS checks; whole-boundary inverse accuracy remains outside frozen interior gate.
